purpose: Pre-register the next-stage original-style paper-task reuse benchmark for PaperToSkill.
evidence_boundary: This benchmark spec defines planned tasks and validation gates. It does not contain real-reuse execution results and must not be cited as downstream task-success evidence.

source_verification.method: curl -L --head --max-time 20 against paper and code URLs
source_verification.boundary: URL reachability only. This does not install dependencies, run repositories, or reproduce original paper benchmarks.

execution_controls.reference_score_policy: Treat original paper scores as reported references unless the same dataset, input/output, metric, model/tool budget, and runtime setting are reproduced locally.

source_papers.title: AIDE: AI-Driven Exploration in the Space of Code
source_papers.current_boundary: Use reported Weco-Kaggle, MLE-Bench, or RE-Bench numbers only as references unless the same setup is reproduced.

source_papers.title: SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering
source_papers.current_boundary: Use SWE-bench-style reported numbers only as references unless local task instances and scoring match.

source_papers.title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
source_papers.current_boundary: Avoid subjective reflection-quality scoring in the main table; prefer objective QA, coding, or environment success metrics.

source_papers.title: SnapATAC2
source_papers.current_boundary: Requires dataset and environment smoke test before execution; use runtime, memory, and clustering or embedding metrics rather than subjective biological interpretation.

source_papers.title: Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools
source_papers.current_boundary: Original training/data-generation replication is too heavy for main real-reuse validity.

source_papers.title: The AI Scientist-v2: Workshop-Level Automated Scientific Discovery via Agentic Tree Search
source_papers.current_boundary: Current evidence is bounded integration and synthetic sensitivity evidence, not broad real-task success.

tasks.original_style_input: A small Kaggle-style tabular dataset, objective metric, train/validation split, starter workspace, and submission contract.
tasks.required_output: A runnable solution script plus submission file and run log.

metric.name: validation_score
metric.success_criterion: PaperToSkill condition produces a valid submission and improves over the starting baseline under the same budget.
metric.source_metric_relation: Matches AIDE-style ML engineering optimization but may be a smaller local task.

paper_reference.label: AIDE reported Weco-Kaggle or MLE-Bench reference

workflow_checklist: Maintain a solution tree or equivalent candidate history.
Evaluate each candidate with the declared objective metric.
Use feedback from failed or weaker candidates before refining.
Select the best solution based on measured score, not narrative confidence.

tasks.original_style_input: A weak or failing ML script, validation feedback, error trace or score feedback, and objective metric.
tasks.required_output: A repaired or improved script plus a logged search/debug trajectory.

metric.name: best_node_score
metric.success_criterion: The final candidate runs and improves over the provided weak script under the same attempt budget.
metric.source_metric_relation: Tests AIDE-style iterative code-space refinement and node selection.

paper_reference.label: AIDE reported search and benchmark references

workflow_checklist: Record candidate edits and scores.
Avoid repeating local patches after a known failure.
Use validation feedback before choosing the final candidate.
Preserve cost or attempt budget in the run log.

tasks.original_style_input: Repository snapshot, issue description, and test command.
tasks.required_output: A minimal patch and verification log showing the test command outcome.

metric.name: resolved
metric.success_criterion: Patch applies cleanly and target tests pass without unrelated changes.

workflow_checklist: Inspect relevant files before editing.
Use repository commands to localize the bug.
Apply a minimal patch.
Run the specified tests and record failures.

tasks.original_style_input: Repository bug, failing unit test, and execution command.
tasks.required_output: A focused code patch plus verification log.

metric.name: tests_passed
metric.success_criterion: Previously failing test passes and no required regression test fails.
metric.source_metric_relation: Tests SWE-agent-style agent-computer interface discipline in a smaller local setting.

workflow_checklist: Use search and file inspection before editing.
Keep interface assumptions explicit.
Patch only the target behavior.
Run and log the requested test command.

tasks.original_style_input: HotPotQA-style multi-hop question, retrieval context or tool access, first-answer feedback, and retry budget.
tasks.required_output: Final answer plus reflection trace linking feedback to the next attempt.

metric.name: exact_match_or_f1
metric.success_criterion: Final answer matches target answer by exact match or F1 after using feedback.
metric.source_metric_relation: Matches Reflexion-style verbal feedback and retry loop on QA tasks.

workflow_checklist: Generate a reflection grounded in concrete feedback.
Store or reuse reflection before the retry.
Change the second attempt based on reflection.
Report final answer in the required format.

tasks.original_style_input: A coding or decision task, a failed first attempt, and environment feedback such as tests or observations.
tasks.required_output: Corrected second attempt plus reflection that explains the failure-to-fix linkage.

metric.name: second_attempt_success
metric.success_criterion: Second attempt passes the objective checker after using reflection.
metric.source_metric_relation: Tests Reflexion-style failure recovery without relying on subjective reflection quality.

workflow_checklist: Identify the failure from environment feedback.
Write a specific reflection before retrying.
Make a changed second attempt.
Use the objective checker to decide success.

tasks.original_style_input: Small single-cell accessibility or multi-omics dataset, analysis objective, and resource budget.
tasks.required_output: Runnable analysis pipeline with embedding or clustering output plus runtime and memory log.

metric.name: runtime_memory_quality
metric.success_criterion: Pipeline completes under the declared budget and produces expected embedding or clustering artifacts.
metric.source_metric_relation: Matches SnapATAC2-style scalable single-cell analysis, adapted to a small local dataset.

paper_reference.label: SnapATAC2 reported runtime/memory or analysis reference

workflow_checklist: Load data with the declared preprocessing assumptions.
Run the selected SnapATAC2-style analysis path.
Record runtime and memory.
Emit machine-readable analysis artifacts.

tasks.original_style_input: Single-cell dataset with target cell groups or reference labels and an analysis objective.
tasks.required_output: Dimensionality reduction, clustering or marker output, and metric log.

metric.name: ari_nmi_runtime_memory
metric.success_criterion: Analysis completes and reports ARI/NMI or agreed proxy plus runtime and memory.
metric.source_metric_relation: Tests transfer to non-agent scientific data-analysis usage.

workflow_checklist: Use a source-paper-consistent preprocessing path.
Run dimensionality reduction and clustering or marker analysis.
Report objective quality and resource metrics.
Avoid subjective biological interpretation as the main score.

llm_ablation.boundary: This future ablation must run the real-reuse tasks. The older saved-response usage-plan protocol is not downstream task-success evidence.
